title: Google OAuth Successful Authentication
description: Verify that a user can successfully authenticate using Google OAuth and receive a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the Google OAuth login endpoint (/api/auth/google).
Complete authentication via Google login page.
Ensure the system redirects to the callback endpoint with a Google OAuth token.
Send the Google ID token to /api/auth/google/verify to obtain a JWT.
Confirm response contains success=true, a valid JWT token, and user info object.
Use the JWT token to request /api/auth/user endpoint.
Verify the user information corresponds to the authenticated Google user.

title: Google OAuth Authentication Failure
description: Verify system handles invalid or expired Google ID tokens properly during authentication.

steps.description: Submit an invalid or expired Google ID token to /api/auth/google/verify.
Check the response returns a 401 status with appropriate error message.
Send request to /api/auth/user without JWT or with invalid JWT.
Confirm response is 401 Unauthorized.

title: Document Upload and ML Fraud Analysis Success
description: Verify a medical document (PDF/image) can be uploaded, processed, analyzed for fraud, encrypted, stored on IPFS, and the correct metadata returned.

steps.description: Send a valid medical document file to /api/upload.
Verify response success=true with SHA-256 hash, IPFS CID, fraud risk analysis object with confidence and riskFlags.
Confirm metadata contains filename, fileSize, mimeType, processingTime, and timestamp.

title: Document Upload Missing File Error
description: Verify that uploading without a file returns a validation error.

steps.description: Send a POST request to /api/upload with empty multipart form data.
Check the response status is 400 with appropriate error details about missing document file.

title: Document Verification Success
description: Verify the system can check uploaded document integrity by comparing its hash with an expected hash.

steps.description: Upload a valid document to /api/verify along with the correct expectedHash.
Ensure response success=true, valid=true, actualHash matches expectedHash, and an informative message is returned.

title: Document Verification Failure Due to Hash Mismatch
description: Verify the system correctly invalidates a document when the actual hash does not match the expected hash.

steps.description: Send a document file with an incorrect expectedHash to /api/verify.
Confirm response success=true, valid=false, actualHash and expectedHash shown, and a relevant message indicating mismatch.

title: Document Verification Missing Parameters
description: Verify 400 error is returned when document or expectedHash is missing in /api/verify request.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/verify missing the document file.
Response status is 400 with error about missing document.
Send POST request to /api/verify missing the expectedHash parameter.
Response status is 400 with error about missing expectedHash.

title: Download Encrypted Document from IPFS Success
description: Verify encrypted document bytes can be downloaded from IPFS given a valid CID.

steps.description: Make GET request to /api/download/{cid} with a valid IPFS CID.
Validate that response returns application/octet-stream binary data of encrypted document.

title: Download Encrypted Document Missing CID
description: Verify 400 error when requesting /api/download without CID.

steps.description: Make GET request to /api/download/ with empty or missing CID.
Response status is 400 indicating missing CID parameter.

title: Decrypt and View Document Success
description: Verify that the encrypted document fetched from IPFS can be decrypted successfully with a valid AES-256-CBC key and returned in original format.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/decrypt-view with valid CID and correct hex-encoded AES-256 key.
Confirm response returns decrypted document bytes with correct MIME type (pdf/jpeg/png).

title: Decrypt and View Document Failure on Missing Parameters
description: Verify 400 error is returned when CID or key is missing in decrypt view request.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/decrypt-view missing the CID.
Response status is 400 with error about missing CID.
Send POST request to /api/decrypt-view missing the key.
Response status is 400 with error about missing key.

title: Decrypt and View Document Failure on Invalid Key
description: Verify the system returns 500 error on decryption failure due to incorrect AES key.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/decrypt-view with valid CID but incorrect AES key.
Response status is 500 indicating decryption failure.

title: ML Fraud Detection Engine OCR Verification Success
description: Verify ML engine can accept document file or raw text and return valid fraud detection result.

steps.description: Send a valid PDF or image file and recordType to /api/ocr-verify on ML engine.
Ensure response success=true and data object with analysis results.
Send raw document text and filename in JSON to /api/ocr-verify.
Confirm response success=true with appropriate data content.

title: ML Fraud Detection Engine Missing Input Error
description: Verify 400 error when ML engine /api/ocr-verify is called with neither file nor text.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/ocr-verify with empty multipart form data.
Response status is 400 indicating missing file or text.

title: API Backend Health Check
description: Verify the backend health endpoint returns correct health and environment information.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/health.
Validate response contains status, service, version, timestamp, uptime, and environment.

title: ML Engine Health Check
description: Verify ML engine health endpoint returns running status and configuration.

steps.description: Send GET request to ML engine /api/health.
Response includes status, service, version, and gemini_configured flag.

title: JWT Session Management and Logout
description: Verify user sessions are maintained using JWT and logout endpoint clears session correctly.

steps.description: Authenticate user and obtain a JWT.
Access protected endpoints using JWT verifying continued authentication.
Call /api/auth/logout endpoint to clear session/token.
Confirm logout success response and subsequent requests with old JWT are unauthorized.

title: One-Time Use Token Enforcement on Blockchain
description: Verify that tokens minted on Aptos blockchain are consumable only once to prevent reuse or fraud.

steps.description: Mint a one-time-use token on blockchain linked to a medical record.
Consume the token via verification API or frontend verifier.
Ensure token consumption succeeds and any subsequent consumption attempts are rejected.

title: Frontend Issuer Workflow
description: Verify issuer can authenticate, upload document, and receive token ID and address with clear status feedback.

steps.description: Issuer logs in via Google OAuth or connects Aptos wallet.
Navigate to document upload and issuance page.
Upload a valid document and select record type.
Verify the UI displays upload progress, fraud analysis results, and encryption status.
Confirm token minting success and display of token ID and issuer address.

title: Frontend Verifier Workflow
description: Verify verifier can input token details, query blockchain for validity, download, decrypt document, and consume token with UI feedback.

steps.description: Verifier accesses verification page and inputs token ID and issuer address.
Trigger blockchain query to verify token validity and fetch document metadata.
Verify UI shows token validity, metadata, and option to download encrypted document.
Download and decrypt document using authorized key.
Ensure decrypted document is viewable in UI.
Consume the token using blockchain transaction through frontend.
Verify UI confirms successful token consumption and disables reuse.
